sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN order_id END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 统计范围为2026年8月（2026-08-01至2026-09-01，按整月口径）当前客户青禾，统计单位为CRM会员账户；本次未按门店筛选或分组，数据来自合成测试库。结果：有效订单均额为37.15元/单；购买会员人均消费为66.87元/账户；购买频次为1.80单/账户；单均商品件数为1.22件/单。四项指标分母均非零，均为已定义结果；当前仅返回汇总值，不能据此拆分门店或判断更细维度差异。
